C-SCOPE-AUDIT-ATTRIBUTION.Summary: Stop auditScopeOutsideWriteScope attributing the approve gate's spec.xml and plan.xml stamps to the executor, and stop the changed-files (base-diffing) audit re-reporting closed bundles present-tense. Two mechanisms, both required, neither dead: (1) identity-keyed exemption of the reviewed bundle's spec.xml and plan.xml inside the changed-files audit only, via a sibling predicate of isCliLifecyclePath, not an extension of it; (2) when resolveChangePlanPath returns location archive, the changed-files audit is not-run. auditWriteEvidenceOutsideScope keeps raising on spec.xml and plan.xml. Overturns the C-REPORT-HONESTY plan T-004 clause that forbids excluding those two files, and the live red AC-SCOPE-LIFECYCLE-EXCLUSION at src/review/core.test.ts. Pays F137, F150, F155. Entirely inside M-REVIEW.
C-SCOPE-AUDIT-ATTRIBUTION.Problem:
Registry row C-SCOPE-AUDIT-ATTRIBUTION in docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/decisions.md (heading Named-bundle registry, named 2026-09-04 by F155) charters this bundle. F137, F150, F150.2, and F155 in the same file are the binding records. This spec does not restate them in place of those records.
Two audits read two different inputs and must not be treated alike. Measured at authoring HEAD 86c5787 by reading src/review/core.ts:
auditScopeOutsideWriteScope (export at the function named that) reads a changed-file set from resolveScopeChangedFiles (explicit --changed-files, --base, recorded approve base, or porcelain). The writer of a path in that set is unknown. isCliLifecyclePath already skips run.xml, run-ledger.xml, and run/** (F11). It does not match spec.xml or plan.xml. The approve gate is the sanctioned writer of those two files (stampApproveArtifact since C-APPROVAL-FINGERPRINT). The audit therefore reports a true statement about the diff and a false statement about the work (F137 at close, F150 at plan approve).
auditWriteEvidenceOutsideScope (export at the function named that) reads WriteEvidence content paths from the executor's own ledger. A spec.xml or plan.xml entry there is the executor claiming it wrote the approved spec. That is a real breach signal. The function also calls isCliLifecyclePath (F11) and isDocsPlansPath (F27.1). Its doc comment states the immutability intent this bundle must not weaken: non-lifecycle .ngrace/ paths (spec.xml, plan.xml, graph, verification) raise when undeclared.
Q1, derived from that sharing, not from the registry row's wording. The row names two candidate mechanisms and says "via isCliLifecyclePath". Extending isCliLifecyclePath to spec.xml / plan.xml would skip those paths in both audits, because WriteEvidence calls the same helper. That would silence the breach signal F155 says must keep firing. The exemption therefore cannot be an extension of isCliLifecyclePath. It is a sibling predicate used only by auditScopeOutsideWriteScope, keyed on the reviewed change id already passed as identity (the bundle's spec.xml and plan.xml under .ngrace/changes/{active|archive}/<id>/, both location prefixes). A spec.xml of a different C-* still raises. Direct helper calls without identity fail closed (still raise).
Mechanism A (that exemption) pays F137 and F150 on live bundles under changes/active/. It does not pay F155's unbounded archive case. Measured 2026-09-04 at HEAD 86c5787: bun ./src/grace.ts review --change C-VERDICT-EVIDENCE --path . exits 1, Findings: 64, all review.scope-outside-write-scope, Scope audit ran over 108 changed file(s) against recorded-base 72f911c. None of the 64 is C-VERDICT-EVIDENCE's own spec.xml or plan.xml (root status superseded on both artifacts). Classes: spec.xml 12, plan.xml 11 (other bundles), other .ngrace/changes 3, docs/plans 4, src 19, other 15 including .ngrace-lint.json. Mechanism A identity-keyed against the reviewed id silences 0 of those 64. Cross-bundle exemption of every C-*/spec.xml would still leave 41 and would hide an executor of C-A editing C-B's spec.
Mechanism B (scope the changed-files audit to changes/active/) pays F155: when resolveChangePlanPath returns location archive, the audit is not-run and does not call resolveScopeChangedFiles or auditScopeOutsideWriteScope. Status must be not-run (reason names archive location), not ran-over-N with zero findings — that zero-denominator shape is F150.1's trap. Predicate is location, not status: an applied bundle still under active/ (the close window F137 actually occupies) still runs. WriteEvidence is not a base-diffing audit (it reads the ledger, not git diff) and is not scoped to active/.
Neither mechanism makes the other dead. A alone leaves C-VERDICT-EVIDENCE's 64 and C-REVIEW-ARCHIVE-SCOPE's present-tense pair (measured 3 at this HEAD: own spec.xml, own plan.xml, and docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/decisions.md — F150.2's contingent third, this branch's 86c5787). B alone leaves F137/F150 on every live close and plan-approve, because those fire while location is still active. They overlap only on an archived bundle's own spec.xml/plan.xml; that overlap is not the live cost.
Q2, the discriminating case a reviewer must still catch after this ships: an executor WriteEvidence path .ngrace/changes/active/C-X/spec.xml (or plan.xml) outside <ObservedWriteScope> still emits review.write-evidence-outside-scope. Existing test "raise: undeclared non-lifecycle .ngrace/ path (approved-spec shape)" at src/review/core.test.ts already holds this. The four immortal live WriteEvidence findings measured at this HEAD are not that shape — they name test files (src/verification/localize.test.ts, src/gates/core.test.ts, and twice src/test-support/token-accounting.test.ts) — and they stay. Counterweights: src/secret.ts in the changed-file set of an active bundle still emits review.scope-outside-write-scope; a different C-* spec.xml in that set still emits it; F11 run/* stays silent.
The criterion this bundle overturns, named as CLAUDE.md rule 9 requires. C-REPORT-HONESTY's approved plan T-004 Criterion says "Do not exclude plan.xml / spec.xml" (.ngrace/changes/archive/C-REPORT-HONESTY/plan.xml T-004, Satisfies AC-SCOPE-LIFECYCLE-EXCLUSION). The live red "AC-SCOPE-LIFECYCLE-EXCLUSION: plan.xml and spec.xml are not excluded" asserts it. brownfield-run4-findings.md recorded the same as intentional approved-artifact immutability, F11 having paid the CLI-lifecycle half. This bundle overturns that clause and that red. It does not overturn F11's run.xml / run-ledger.xml / run/** exclusion, which is the body of the spec-level AC-SCOPE-LIFECYCLE-EXCLUSION in that archived spec.
The answer to the immutability argument: auditApprovedArtifact already covers spec.xml and plan.xml byte-exactly while root status is approved, via review.approved-fingerprint-mismatch (and review.approval-never-asked when no applying permit exists). The changed-files audit cannot tell the gate's sanctioned status stamp from an agent's edit, which is why it produces F137/F150. Residual limits of auditApprovedArtifact, read from the function and from classifyApprovedArtifact, stated not discovered later: (1) it continues past any artifact whose root status is not approved, so applied / superseded / draft / cancelled / rejected are silent — apply mutates the status attribute, so the approve fingerprint cannot cover post-apply bytes; (2) unfingerprinted Decisions are silent on the catalogued review errors (existing test; F108.2 row three); (3) git-unavailable is returned by classifyApprovedArtifact and ignored by this audit; (4) it runs only when --change is supplied; (5) it inspects only spec.xml and plan.xml; (6) catalog: tamper-evidence, not enforcement, does not refuse gate apply. collectApprovedContractDrift (ngrace status) walks activeScopes only and is not this bundle's surface. Unsanctioned edits to applied archive artifacts remain process plus git; this bundle does not invent a second immutability audit for applied bytes.

Goals.Goal: auditScopeOutsideWriteScope does not emit review.scope-outside-write-scope for the reviewed change id's spec.xml or plan.xml, under either .ngrace/changes/active/<id>/ or .ngrace/changes/archive/<id>/. The skip is a sibling predicate of isCliLifecyclePath, used only by this audit, keyed on identity.changeId. isCliLifecyclePath's matched set stays run.xml, run-ledger.xml, and run/**.

When resolveChangePlanPath returns location archive, runReview does not run the changed-files audit: Scope audit status is not-run, the reason names that the plan resolved under archive/, and neither resolveScopeChangedFiles nor auditScopeOutsideWriteScope is called for that review. Location, not status, and not input source: --changed-files does not re-open an archived bundle. An applied plan still under changes/active/ still runs.

auditWriteEvidenceOutsideScope is unchanged in path-class exclusions. WriteEvidence of spec.xml or plan.xml outside <ObservedWriteScope> still emits review.write-evidence-outside-scope on active and on archive. The four immortal live findings named in Problem stay.

This spec overturns the C-REPORT-HONESTY plan T-004 clause "Do not exclude plan.xml / spec.xml" and inverts the live red at src/review/core.test.ts without dropping an assertion (flipping toBe(true) to toBe(false) does not trip review.test-assertion-weakened; dropping one would). F11's run/** AC-SCOPE-LIFECYCLE-EXCLUSION tests stay green.
README.md and examples/ are unchanged; no user-visible CLI, config, or review command surface is added. Existing ngrace review --change emits fewer misattributed findings.

Exemption shape, normative: the changed-files skip is identity-keyed to the reviewed change id, both location prefixes, files spec.xml and plan.xml only. It is not a path-class extension of isCliLifecyclePath and not a skip of all .ngrace/changes/**. A spec.xml or plan.xml whose change-id segment differs from identity.changeId still raises. A non-canonical directory (scratch/) still raises. decisions.md and other docs/plans/ paths still raise on the changed-files audit (F150.2 residual on live bundles; F27.1 remains WriteEvidence-only).

Archive predicate is location, not status. resolveChangePlanPath already returns location active | archive from the path. In the applied-but-active window a location filter still runs the changed-files audit; a status skip of applied would go silent at close, which is exactly when F137 fires. Mechanism B therefore cannot be implemented as "skip when root status is applied or superseded". Acceptance tests must discriminate: archive location not-run; active+applied still runs the helper (and mechanism A then silences only that bundle's spec.xml / plan.xml).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-GATE-STAMP-SILENT: Given identity changeId C-A and changed files including .ngrace/changes/active/C-A/plan.xml and .ngrace/changes/active/C-A/spec.xml plus F11 lifecycle companions, with <ObservedWriteScope> that does not list those two files, auditScopeOutsideWriteScope emits no review.scope-outside-write-scope on C-A's spec.xml or plan.xml. Lifecycle companions stay silent. Failure conditions: those two files still raise; skip implemented by extending isCliLifecyclePath; skip implemented by emptying .ngrace/changes/**.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-IDENTITY-KEYED: The same helper, identity changeId C-A, changed files including .ngrace/changes/active/C-B/spec.xml (a different canonical C-*), still emits review.scope-outside-write-scope on C-B's spec.xml. Without identity, C-A's own spec.xml still raises (fail closed). Failure conditions: any C-*/spec.xml is silenced; omitted identity silences the reviewed id.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-WRITE-EVIDENCE-KEPT: Discriminating breach. WriteEvidence path .ngrace/changes/active/C-X/spec.xml outside <ObservedWriteScope> still emits review.write-evidence-outside-scope. The existing test "raise: undeclared non-lifecycle .ngrace/ path (approved-spec shape)" stays green. The same for plan.xml. Failure conditions: isCliLifecyclePath gained spec.xml / plan.xml leaves; WriteEvidence helper skips those paths.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-COUNTERWEIGHT-SRC: Stay-true. auditScopeOutsideWriteScope on F11 lifecycle paths plus src/secret.ts still emits review.scope-outside-write-scope on src/secret.ts and only that path. Existing counterweight test stays green. Do not manufacture a red (F45).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LIFECYCLE-RUN-KEPT: Stay-true. F11 AC-SCOPE-LIFECYCLE-EXCLUSION tests for run.xml, run-ledger.xml, run/** (any C-*, cross-bundle fold, fold deletions, non-canonical scratch still raises) stay green. isCliLifecyclePath matched set is unchanged. Do not manufacture a red (F45).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-NOT-RUN: runReview --change of a bundle whose plan.xml resolves under changes/archive/ reports Scope audit status not-run (printed line begins with "Scope audit: not-run") and the reason names archive. It does not report ran over N changed files with zero out-of-scope paths. Explicit --changed-files does not override. Failure conditions: archive review still diffs recorded-base; status is ran with 0 findings; skip is by root status applied or superseded rather than location.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCATION-NOT-STATUS: Predicate discrimination for mechanism B. A plan with status="applied" under changes/active/ still runs the changed-files audit (mechanism A then silences only that id's spec.xml / plan.xml). The same plan under changes/archive/ is not-run. A status skip of applied would silence both; this pair must not both be not-run. Failure conditions: active+applied not-run; archive skipped only when status is not applied.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-WRITE-EVIDENCE-ARCHIVE: Stay-true. WriteEvidence still runs on archive location. A review of C-CRITERION-CLOSE-EVIDENCE still emits review.write-evidence-outside-scope on src/verification/localize.test.ts (or the fixture equivalent). Do not manufacture a red (F45). Failure conditions: WriteEvidence scoped to active/; the four immortal live findings disappear.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FINGERPRINT-KEPT: Stay-true. auditApprovedArtifact still emits review.approved-fingerprint-mismatch for an approved spec whose bytes differ from the applying permit fingerprint, and still emits review.approval-never-asked when no applying permit exists. Unfingerprinted Decisions stay silent on those two codes. Do not manufacture a red (F45).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-TEST-COUNT: The rewritten "plan.xml and spec.xml are not excluded" test keeps at least its current three expect() calls; the two that today are toBe(true) become toBe(false). Assertion count in that test does not fall. review.test-assertion-weakened must not fire on this rewrite. Failure conditions: an expect dropped; the test deleted and replaced by a smaller one.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-NEW-ARGV: Stay-true. src/grace.ts command registration and lint / gate / review arg maps gain no new token. The change is consumed by the existing ngrace review command. Do not manufacture a red (F45).
